entry.title: Missing AI agent cost data is not zero
entry.summary:
Missing AI agent cost data is not zero
My agent spend ledger showed $0 for the day. The agents had run all morning. The number was a lie, and the bug behind it is one almost every cost tracker ships with. Short version: when a provider's billing data has not arrived yet, a naive cost tracker records $0 for that period. For AI agents that run unattended, this hides the exact spending you built the tracker to catch. The fix is to model missing data as a distinct "unknown" state, never as zero, so a day you cannot measure reads as unmeasured instead of free. I run a fleet of scheduled agents. They digest articles, review drafts, sweep a queue overnight. Real model calls, real dollars. entry.title: The Laptop That Changed A Village
entry.summary: The Old Classroom Sana lived in a small village near Lahore. Her dream was simple: "I want to learn coding". Her father said: "Beta, online education is for city kids. Sana smiled and said: "Abbu, all I need is internet and hope." The First Click One day, her cousin gifted her an old laptop. That night, Sana used her neighbor's WiFi for 10 minutes. The screen lit up with thousands of lessons. 2 AM Classes Electricity in her village came only after midnight. 11 PM: Finish household work Her eyes burned. Her back hurt. The Transformation 6 months later... Sana built her first website - for her father's small shop. The girl who had no school computer... The Lesson Last month, someone asked her: She replied: "It didn't just teach me coding. Your zip code doesn't decide your future. Today that old laptop is not old anymore. MORAL OF THE STORY Online education didn't replace teachers. You don't need a big city. The classroom is now everywhere. YOUR TURN What's one free course you started but never finished? Comment below. Let's restart together.
